card.title: GORDON HIGHLANDERS
card.text: Deployment: Choose an order in hand. Set its cost to 0 and put it on top of your deck.
card.flavorText: The Gordon Highlanders was a regiment of the British Army which was active from 1881 to 1994. During WWII its battalions fought in nearly every theater. The 1st Battalion came to France with the BEF in September 1939.  It joined the 51st (Highland) Division in May 1940, but most of the division was captured at Saint-Valéry-en-Caux in June. The 1st battalion was later reformed and fought in North Africa, Sicily, and Northwest Europe, ending the war in Germany. The 2nd Battalion, stationed in Malaya, was captured by the Japanese at Singapore in 1942, and suffered more losses during captivity than in battle. Reformed later that year, it fought in Normandy, the Netherlands, and Germany. The 4th Battalion served as a machine gun unit before becoming the 92nd Anti-Tank Regiment. The 5th and 7th Battalions were united and saw combat in North Africa and Normandy. The 6th Battalion fought in France, North Africa, Italy, and ended the war in Palestine. The 8th Battalion converted to artillery, while the 9th became an armored unit. Both served in Burma.
